offlineWiki.title: Effects — Random effects
offlineWiki.use: Weights are relative scores; conditional selection chance is proportional to each eligible weight divided by the local sum. Modifier blocks and variable weights are possible.

offlineWiki.title: Decision modding — Fixed random seed
offlineWiki.path: paradox_wiki/Decision modding - Hearts of Iron 4 Wiki.md
offlineWiki.use: Decisions use a fixed random seed by default; `fixed_random_seed = no` makes the seed dynamic.

offlineWiki.title: Scopes — random_list table entry
offlineWiki.use: Random-list outcome probability is proportional to weight; listed values need not sum to 100.

installedGameDocumentation.title: effects_documentation.md — random_list
installedGameDocumentation.use: random_list supports any scope, weights can be current-scope variables, and an explicit seed may select its random stream.
